title: Seaside Cottage Near Beach Access Sleeps 6
meta_description: 3BR Seaside cottage for 6 on Forest Street with screened porches, outdoor living, and a short walk to the beach, Amphitheater, and Central Square.
description_expanded: Welcome to Brigadoon | A Classic Forest Street Cottage in Seaside, FloridaNestled along picturesque Forest Street, Brigadoon is a cheerful blue beach home offering the perfect blend of classic Seaside charm and walkable convenience. This inviting three-bedroom home is just a 3-minute walk to the private beach access at Pensacola Pavilion and an easy 6-minute stroll to the Seaside Amphitheater, Central Square, and more than 35 shops and restaurants. Whether you’re headed to the beach or exploring town, Brigadoon places you right in the heart of it all.Welcoming Porches & Outdoor LivingUpon arrival, you’ll be greeted by a spacious, furnished front porch featuring three classic rocking chairs—an ideal spot for morning coffee, afternoon people-watching, or evening conversations over charcuterie and a nightcap. Out back, a wooden deck with a charcoal grill and outdoor shower makes it easy to transition from beach days to relaxed evenings at home.Bright, Open First-Floor LivingStep inside to a bright and open first-floor living space designed for gathering and connection. The living room is filled with natural light and offers direct access to the front porch, creating a seamless indoor-outdoor flow. The fully equipped kitchen features a center island with seating for three, an electric four-burner cooktop, and both a Keurig and traditional coffee maker, making meal prep easy and enjoyable. Adjacent, the dining area comfortably seats six and opens to the porch, perfect for shared meals and game nights. A convenient half bathroom completes the first floor.Comfortable Upstairs Bedrooms & Screened PorchUpstairs, guests will find three well-appointed bedrooms and an additional screened porch for peaceful relaxation. The primary bedroom features a queen bed, private ensuite bathroom, and porch access—ideal for quiet mornings or winding down in the evening. The ensuite bath includes dual vanities and a tub/shower combination.The second bedroom offers two twin beds with porch access, while the third bedroom features a queen bed and ample storage. These two guest rooms share a full bathroom with dual vanities and a tub/shower combo, providing comfort and convenience for families or groups. The shared screened porch offers lounge seating for four and is a favorite spot for evening breezes.Thoughtful Amenities for a Relaxed StayBrigadoon is equipped with free Wi-Fi, cable TV, air conditioning, and a washer and dryer, ensuring a comfortable and carefree stay. With its prime location, inviting porches, and timeless Seaside style, Brigadoon is the perfect coastal retreat—once you arrive, you may never want to leave.* 5 night minimum Spring, Spring Break, & Summer. 3 Night minimum Fall. 2 Night minimum Winter. Must be 25 or older to rent & sign registrationFEATURES1,824 square feetPrivate Seaside residential beach access at Pensacola PavilionSeaside is home to the largest private residential beach on 30AJust 176 yards (3-minute walk) to beach accessKeurig and traditional coffee makerPeacock Alley Premier Linen Partner – fresh, luxurious Peacock Alley towels, sheets, and coverlets throughout the homeAccess to 3 swimming pools, 5 clay tennis courts, 3 pickleball courts (court fees apply), and a fitness centerWelcome tote with 2 beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and 2 complimentary rental bikes for pickup at the Seaside Transit AuthorityPersonalized service throughout your stay with starter amenities provided2 parking passes are issued. A golf cart is considered a car, and for non-homeowners visiting Seaside are prohibited. Special circumstances and medical needs requests require a golf cart permit.No pets allowed STR24-000533
